_설명: 「사건의 지평선 너머, 마지막 인간」 인물. look = 몸, outfit = 옷·장비, face = 사용자 확인한 시트

chars.name: 서하
chars.look: a Korean woman astronaut explorer in her late 20s, short black hair tied back, determined dark eyes, a small scar on her chin, slim athletic build
chars.look_ko: 20대 후반 한국인 여성 탐사대원, 묶은 짧은 검은 머리, 단단한 눈, 턱의 작은 흉터
chars.outfit: a worn white and navy space exploration suit with orange stripes on the shoulders, a cracked helmet hanging at her hip, a small glowing blue wrist device, heavy boots

chars.name: 고르
chars.look: a huge blocky golem made of stacked rough grey boulders and stone slabs, not human, no human muscles, no human skin, a wide flat rock head with a heavy stone brow and two small glowing orange eyes, cracks between the stones glowing orange-red like embers, massive stone fists, short thick stone legs, about three meters tall
chars.look_ko: 온몸이 회색 바위인 거대한 바위족 문지기, 갈라진 틈에 주황빛, 3m 키
chars.outfit: no clothes, patches of glowing purple crystals and moss growing on its shoulders

chars.name: 리아
chars.look: a slender plant-like alien girl whose whole body looks like a young sapling with pale green bark skin and visible wood grain, a crown of pale blue-violet leaves instead of hair, large calm glowing eyes, thin branch-like arms with twig fingers, legs that end in small root feet
chars.look_ko: 숲족 소녀, 연두빛 나무껍질 피부, 머리 대신 푸른 보랏빛 잎사귀 관, 크고 차분한 눈
chars.outfit: a long modest dress of overlapping large green leaves and soft moss covering her body from shoulders to ankles

chars.name: 빛해파리
chars.look: a large floating jellyfish creature, no arms, no legs, no human body, a big translucent pale blue ribbed bell-shaped head with a row of small dark eyes along the rim, many long glowing blue and pink tentacles hanging down beneath it, floating in the air, softly bioluminescent
chars.look_ko: 공중에 떠다니는 빛해파리족, 반투명한 푸른 머리, 작은 눈 여러 개, 빛나는 긴 촉수
chars.outfit: no clothes, tiny glowing spores floating around it

chars.name: 한도윤
chars.look: an old Korean man in his late 70s, the former ship captain, long white hair tied back, a short white beard, a kind deeply wrinkled face, calm wise eyes, slightly bent but sturdy
chars.look_ko: 70대 후반 노인이 된 함장, 묶은 흰 머리·흰 수염, 주름진 다정한 얼굴
chars.outfit: a very old faded patched white and navy space suit with orange stripes on the shoulders, a cloak woven from pale leaves over his shoulders, a wooden walking staff
